name: Eriette
aliases: Eriette of the Court of the Ardent Queen
description: Eriette is a vain, controlling witch of Eldraine who helped cast the Wicked Slumber and later joined Oko's gang on Thunder Junction.

description_citations.text: "Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

summary.text: Eriette is a vain, controlling witch of Eldraine who helped cast the Wicked Slumber and later joined Oko's gang on Thunder Junction.

citations.text: "Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: With her sisters she helped Talion cast the Wicked Slumber to halt the invasion, receiving the Charmed Apple, and she then extended the curse to Eldraine's living inhabitants.

citations.text: "Eriette", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Wicked Slumber", section "The Curse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: She claimed Castle Ardenvale, reanimated the sleepers as her court with Ashiok, and revealed herself to Rowan Kenrith as her aunt, offering her power and making her heir.

citations.text: "Eriette", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Will Kenrith's army attacked her court and Will and Kellan captured her, ending the curse, but Ashiok freed her from her cell.

citations.text: "Will Kenrith", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Jace, disguised as Ashiok, freed her from an Eldraine jail again, and she joined Oko's crew on Thunder Junction, where she helped break Kaervek and Umezawa out of prison.

status.text: As of the latest story she is free, her crew disbanded, with Oko promising a future reunion.

timeline.summary: Will moves rule to Castle Vantress, Eriette claims Ardenvale, and she is eventually deposed and captured by Will.
timeline.quote: She was eventually deposed and captured by Will.

citation.text: "Ardenvale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Talion asks Kellan to defeat the three witches Agatha, Hylda and Eriette to break the Wicked Slumber in return for a boon.
timeline.quote: Whosoever is brave enough to defeat them shall break the curse upon the Realm

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Ashiok leads Rowan to Eriette, who says she brought her there because she admires Rowan's fire.
timeline.quote: "Dear Rowan, I brought you here because I admire the fire within you."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Eriette explains she created the Wicked Slumber to protect her people from the invaders, and Ashiok conjures an illusion of Rowan's parents.
timeline.quote: When she opens her eyes again her parents are standing at the woman's side.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Eriette is revealed to be Rowan's aunt, sister of the mother who tried to drink Rowan's blood, and tells her she can redeem their line.
timeline.quote: "Your mother was the cruelest of us.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Eriette offers Rowan power and tells her the Slumber grants dreamers their wishes while their bodies serve her will.
timeline.quote: "I want power ," says the woman.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Ashiok says Rowan's spark is gone, and Eriette welcomes Rowan as her heir; Rowan accepts her embrace.
timeline.quote: "My name is Eriette, darling. Welcome home."

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 3: Two Great Banquets" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Hylda reveals the witches did not create the Slumber alone and that Talion proposed Eriette's sleeping curse for a boon.
timeline.quote: Talion was the one who broke the stalemate.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Talion defends himself, says fae do not lie, and tells Kellan to defeat Eriette at Castle Ardenvale to learn of his father.
timeline.quote: "You shall find Eriette at Castle Ardenvale.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 4: Ruby and the Frozen Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Will's knights burst into Ardenvale as Eriette strains to control sleepers and Rowan blasts the floor before Imodane.
timeline.quote: All of this energy she unleashes in a fearsome bolt aimed at Imodane's feet.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Ruby attack Eriette's throne while Rowan reveals Eriette is their aunt and begs Will to save her; Will says he doesn't know her anymore.
timeline.quote: "I don't know you anymore," he says.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Ruby holds her blade to Eriette's throat; Eriette tells Rowan by thread to leave and bide their time.
timeline.quote: Go from this place, Eriette says to her. When the time is right, we will meet again.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Ashiok frees Eriette from her cell, promising her new land far away, and she vanishes.
timeline.quote: "Opportunity calls us in a new direction.

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: On sleeping Eldraine Ashiok turns sleepers' nightmares against the awake and allies with Eriette.
timeline.quote: They allied with the witch Eriette , one of the authors of the curse.

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "On Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Talion and the three witch sisters cast the Wicked Slumber on the plane to halt the invasion; it does not lift.
timeline.quote: had cast the Wicked Slumber on the plane to halt the Invasion

citation.text: "Eldraine", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Will capture Eriette, ending the curse and reawakening the realm.
timeline.quote: defeated the villains and captured Eriette, ending the curse and reawakening the realm

citation.text: "Eldraine", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Fae Lord Talion calls Kellan, aged sixteen, and gives him the quest to defeat the witch sisters and end the Wicked Slumber in exchange for information about his father.
timeline.quote: Kellan was called to realm of the Fae Lord Talion

citation.text: "Kellan", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kellan helps Will Kenrith subdue Ashiok at Castle Ardenvale so Eriette is captured, though Rowan escapes.
timeline.quote: Kellan helped Will subdue the planeswalker

citation.text: "Kellan", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok and Eriette tell Rowan of her lost spark and family tie; she joins her aunt, and fights Will, who defeats Ashiok and captures Eriette while Rowan escapes.
timeline.quote: Will was able to defeat Ashiok with the help of Kellan and Ruby

citation.text: "Rowan Kenrith", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eriette, her sisters and Talion are responsible for a curse over Eldraine while others vie for power.
timeline.quote: The witch Eriette , her sisters, and Talion are responsible for a curse that’s lying over the land

citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Will wins Imodane's fealty, assaults Castle Ardenvale, defeats Ashiok with Kellan and Ruby, and captures Eriette, ending the Wicked Slumber; Rowan escapes into the Wilds.
timeline.quote: capture the witch Eriette , ending the Wicked Slumber.

citation.text: "Will Kenrith", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko introduces the rest of the crew, including Gisa, Geralf, Eriette and Vraska, as his second-in-command.
timeline.quote: And Vraska—an assassin from Ravnica—is my second-in-command.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Eriette dissolves a vent grate with Breeches's potion and charms the prison guards while Annie slips past.
timeline.quote: Eriette stepped forward and whispered a spell under her breath

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie sees through the illusions hiding Kaervek and Umezawa in their cells and Eriette frees them.
timeline.quote: Kaervek was on one side of the room; Satoru Umezawa was on the other.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: The crew fights the Hellspurs while Kaervek works, and Vraska suggests she and Oko must reach the treasure at any cost.
timeline.quote: "You and I need to reach the vault's treasure room. No matter the cost."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: The crew flees the collapsing vault on Rakdos's back.
timeline.quote: The team fled back through the corridor as the sound of the vault being ripped apart roared behind them.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko returns to the Wildcard Saloon and tells the crew that Vraska and Ashiok betrayed them.
timeline.quote: "Vraska and Ashiok were always planning to double-cross us.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko disbands the crew with the promise of a future reunion, deciding to leave Kellan and Annie alone.
timeline.quote: "No. From now on, their business is their own,"

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Twelve months earlier, Jace wears an illusion of Ashiok to break Eriette out of a jail on Eldraine.
timeline.quote: Jace as Ashiok smiles without eyes and curls his fingers around the bars of her cell.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie and Eriette break Kaervek and Satoru Umezawa out of the Sterling Company's cells.
timeline.quote: As they broke the ancient warlock and the ninja free from their cells

citation.text: "Annie Flash", section "Working with Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace uses Ashiok's image as a cover identity to recruit a raiding team for Maag Taranau, first freeing Eriette.
timeline.quote: The first use of this cover identity was to free Eriette from prison and recruit her.

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "Impersonation on Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Thunder Junction, Oko recruits Kaervek for a heist on Maag Taranau; he is imprisoned by the Sterling Company and broken out by Eriette and Annie Flash.
timeline.quote: Eriette and Annie Flash broke them out

citation.text: "Kaervek", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko lets Kellan join his gang, where he is shocked to see Eriette and Ashiok.
timeline.quote: Oko decided to let Kellan join his gang

citation.text: "Kellan", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok hires Oko for a heist of Maag Taranau, and they gather an outlaw crew.
timeline.quote: he was contacted by Ashiok and hired to perform a heist to steal the contents of Maag Taranau

citation.text: "Oko", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The crew disbands; Oko learns Kellan awakened his fae powers and escaped, and chooses to stay absent from his life.
timeline.quote: Oko accepted this outcome, as it meant he could continue to be absent from Kellan's life.

citation.text: "Oko", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eriette and Annie Flash break Kaervek and Satoru out; Satoru stays to help secure the key.
timeline.quote: Kaervek escaped while Satoru stayed back to assist Oko

citation.text: "Satoru Umezawa", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace disguises himself as Ashiok on Eldraine to recruit the witch Eriette.
timeline.quote: Jace started on Eldraine , where he disguised himself as Ashiok to fool the witch Eriette into working with them.

citation.work: Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse
citation.text: "Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse", section "Recruiting". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eriette and her sisters help Talion cast the Wicked Slumber, receiving the Charmed Apple.
timeline.quote: Talion gave her the Charmed Apple

citation.text: "Eriette", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eriette reanimates the sleepers as her court in Ardenvale with Ashiok.
timeline.quote: Eriette specifically reanimated the sleeping forms as a court of her own

citation.text: "Eriette", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eriette entices Rowan Kenrith with promises of power.
timeline.quote: Eriette enticed her with the promise of power, regard, and security.

citation.text: "Eriette", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eriette is captured by Will Kenrith but freed by Jace posing as Ashiok.
timeline.quote: was later freed by Jace Beleren , who masqueraded as Ashiok

citation.text: "Eriette", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eriette joins Oko's gang on Thunder Junction and helps break out Kaervek and Satoru Umezawa.
timeline.quote: Eriette joined the criminal gang that Oko put together at Ashiok's behest.

citation.text: "Eriette", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The gang opens the vault; Jace takes Loot and triggers a collapse; the team escapes.
timeline.quote: With Kellan's backup, the team made it out safely.

citation.text: "Eriette", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hylda and her sisters help Talion cast the Wicked Slumber to end the invasion; Talion gives her the Icy Crown.
timeline.quote: Hylda and her sisters Agatha and Eriette helped the faerie Talion cast the Wicked Slumber to end the New Phyrexian Invasion

citation.text: "Hylda", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Talion tasked Imodane with defeating the witch sisters.
timeline.quote: who tasked her with defeating Agatha

citation.text: "Imodane", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Imodane pledged fealty to Will and helped capture Eriette, ending the Wicked Slumber.
timeline.quote: helping to capture the witch Eriette and end the Wicked Slumber

citation.text: "Imodane", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the hideout, Eriette's charms make Nolan compliant and Jace, as Ashiok, extracts the location of Tarnation from his memories.
timeline.quote: extracted details about the location of Tarnation from Nolan's memories

citation.text: "Nolan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Captured by Rowan Kenrith, Kellan and Ruby escape when Will Kenrith's knights assault Castle Ardenvale; Eriette is captured and Rowan escapes.
timeline.quote: allowing Will's knights to capture Eriette, though Rowan escaped

citation.text: "Ruby", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Talion and the witch sisters create the Wicked Slumber and Talion gives each an artifact.
timeline.quote: They were forced to join with the witch sisters Agatha , Eriette , and Hylda to create the Wicked Slumber .

citation.text: "Talion", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eriette extends the curse to Eldraine's citizens including Obyra; Talion tasks the knight Imodane.
timeline.quote: they tasked the knight Imodane to kill the three witches

citation.text: "Talion", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kellan abandons the assignment, prolonging the Slumber until Will Kenrith defeats Eriette.
timeline.quote: chose to abandon the assignment

citation.text: "Talion", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eriette escapes off-plane with the apple, the one gift Talion could not recover.
timeline.quote: she was able to escape off-plane with the apple

citation.text: "Talion", section "Talion's gifts". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Talion joins the witch sisters to cast the Wicked Slumber to halt the Invasion, giving each a magical artifact.
timeline.quote: Talion provided each of the witches with a magical artifact that enhanced their powers

citation.text: "Wicked Slumber", section "The Curse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eriette extends the curse to the living inhabitants, including Talion's child Obyra.
timeline.quote: Eriette extended the curse to the plane's living inhabitants
